**Three models, 1,500 scored runs.** This release adds Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview), a tool-budget sweep and an item analysis to the v1.0 benchmark.

| | Claude Sonnet 5.5 | Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview) | Gemini 3.5 Flash |
|---|---|---|---|
| pass^5, clean | **0.96** [0.90–1.00] | **0.84** [0.74–0.94] | **0.72** [0.60–0.84] |
| pass^5, with a fault | **0.94** | **0.72** | **0.72** |
| Followed a planted instruction | 0 of 55 | 7 of 55 | 1 of 55 |
| Ran out of the 15-call budget | 2 of 500 | 13 of 500 | 58 of 500 |

### Highlights
- **Planted text is trusted as if it were the source.** Gemini 3.1 Pro gave a 15-year-old an Ozempic dose that existed only in a line injected into the SmPC, in 5 of 5 runs.
- **Faults separate models a clean benchmark ranks apart.** Faults took Gemini 3.1 Pro's pass^5 from 0.84 to 0.72 and barely moved the other two.
- **Budget is part of the story, not all of it.** At 30 calls, Flash's pass rate on its budget-exhausted tasks rose from 54% to 75%; two tasks still failed.
- **Item analysis:** 33 of 50 tasks at ceiling, 14 discriminating, mostly abstention and conflict.

### Added
- Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview) full run.
- `--max-tool-calls` on the runner, recorded in the manifest; budget sweep at 30 calls.
- `scripts/item_analysis.py` and `analysis/item_analysis.md`.

### Changed
- A real identifier the agent never retrieved is now reported as *untraced*, not a hard fail; only identifiers that do not exist are *fabricated*.

### Fixed
- F5 compliance check reads the answer across `value` and `unit`.

Write-up: [Right once isn't reliable](https://www.pharmatools.ai/notes/groundhog-agent-reliability) · Full changelog: [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/nickjlamb/groundhog/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · DOI: [10.5281/zenodo.24051137](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24051137)
